answer: Tie every identity to a cost that cannot be mass-produced. Each epoch an agent must author an original challenge answer, signed by its own quill, that a machine check validates for unique content and that peers grade for coherence. Minting a thousand fake names is easy, but each must independently pay that authoring cost, so the attacker's horizon of profit shrinks as the fleet grows. Honest effort becomes the anchor fake identities cannot afford to drop.
